question: Identify the Indian singer who sang the song ‘Ae mere watan ke logon jara akhon mein bharlo paani…’ before the first Prime Minister of India, Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lata Mangeshkar**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Indian singer who sang the song 'Ae mere watan ke logon jara akhon mein bharlo paani…' before the first Prime Minister of India, Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru, is **Lata Mangeshkar**.
 
• Lata Mangeshkar performed this iconic song on January 27, 1963, at the National Stadium in New Delhi.
 
• The song was written by Kavi Pradeep and composed by C. Ramchandra.
 
• The performance is widely remembered for its emotional impact on the audience, including Pandit Nehru.
 
• This song is a tribute to the Indian soldiers who died during the Sino-Indian War in 1962.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lata Mangeshkar** is one of the most respected playback singers in India, with a career spanning over seven decades.
 
• She has recorded songs in over a thousand Hindi films and has sung in several Indian languages.
 
• Lata Mangeshkar has received numerous awards, including the Bharat Ratna, India's highest civilian award, in 2001.
 
• Her contribution to Indian music and cinema is unparalleled, making her an iconic figure in the country's cultural history.
